intro: Analyses camshaft timing: overlap, LSA, opening and closing points, dynamic compression and powerband.

r.timing_text: IVO {ivo}° BTDC · IVC {ivc}° ABDC · EVO {evo}° BBDC · EVC {evc}° ATDC
r.band_note: Indicative: also depends on the head and intake

warn.overlap_high: Large overlap: rough idle and little low-rpm torque.
warn.overlap_boost: A lot of overlap for a boosted engine: part of the charge is lost to the exhaust.
warn.lsa_tight: Tight LSA: strong torque over a narrow band, difficult idle.
warn.lsa_wide: Wide LSA: smooth idle but slightly less peak power.
warn.dcr_low: Low dynamic ratio: weak low end; raise static compression or close the intake earlier.
warn.dcr_high: High dynamic ratio for a naturally aspirated engine: knock risk on pump fuel.
